name: Neon
description: Serverless Postgres on Neon: projects, branches and SQL.
long_description:
Neon's own hosted server. It lists projects and branches, runs SQL, describes tables, and branches a database for an experiment in one call.

You sign in through Neon in your browser. A branch is cheap and reversible; dropping one is not, and is confirmed every time.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Neon in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Runs SQL and manages branches on your Neon projects. Deleting a branch or a project is confirmed every time.
